title: Serialize release and coverage badge writes to main
description: As a maintainer, I want automated main writers serialized so successful CI can publish a release without the coverage badge racing it. Observed Release run 39046316429 fail after build because Coverage Badge run 39046316427 moved main from 807b184 to 2cb44f7. Scope: repository workflow concurrency only; retain existing CI/release gates, bot auth and shared reusable workflows. Plan: reproduce concurrency mismatch, assign the same non-cancelling group to both callers, validate workflow syntax and checks, merge via PR, follow deployment/release/PyPI. Acceptance: Given successful main CI, when Release and Coverage Badge run, then only one may write main at a time and both can finish without cancelling each other.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Specification before implementation: Given successful main CI, when the release and coverage badge workflows are triggered together, then their main writes must be mutually exclusive and neither running writer is cancelled. Reproduction: YAML assertion requiring matching non-cancelling concurrency failed: release group=release, badge group=coverage-badge. Observed production failure confirms this permits simultaneous writers. Smallest fix: shared main-automation group at workflow level in the two Biblicus callers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented the two-line concurrency fix in the release and coverage callers. The same YAML assertion now passes; git diff --check passes. No Python/application behavior changed. Pages root cause was fixed through repository configuration. Next: PR checks, merge, then observe release/PyPI and served docs.
